name: multiping
description: MultiPing - Avalonia desktop app for traceroute and multi-IP latency monitoring

scripts.build:release: dotnet publish MultiPing.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --no-restore -o bin/Release/net10.0/publish
scripts.build:macos:x64: dotnet publish MultiPing.csproj -c Release -r osx-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o bin/Release/net10.0/osx-x64/publish
scripts.build:macos:arm64: dotnet publish MultiPing.csproj -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o bin/Release/net10.0/osx-arm64/publish
scripts.dev: npm run build:debug && npm run launch:debug
scripts.dev:multiping: npm run build:debug && npm run launch:multiping
scripts.dev:plotping: npm run build:debug && npm run launch:plotping
